final: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as percentage_bad_alignment, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) as marvel_comics_bad_count FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
